name: @pipeworx/mcp-dst-dk

tools.name: denmark_population
tools.description: Denmark's total population in ONE call, from Statistics Denmark (Danmarks Statistik, table FOLK1A), keyless — plus the recent quarterly trend. PREFER for "what is Denmark's population", "how many people live in Denmark", "Danish population growth", "Denmark population according to official statistics". Counts are registered residents at the FIRST DAY of each quarter, so "2026Q2" is a 1 April snapshot, not an average over the quarter. Use list_tables / get_data for breakdowns by region, age, sex or marital status.

quarters.description: How many recent quarters to include in the trend (1-40, default 8). The headline figure is always the newest.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Browse the Statistics Denmark subject tree (People, Labour, Economy, Business, Environment, ...). Pass a subject id to drill into its children; set recursive to expand the whole subtree.

subjects.description: Comma-separated subject id(s) to drill into (e.g. "1"). Omit for the top-level tree.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List/search available tables. Filter by subject id, free-text search, or recently-updated tables. Returns table ids (use with table_info / get_data), titles, period range, and variable names.

subjects.description: Comma-separated subject id(s) to filter by (from list_subjects).

search.description: Free-text filter matched against table ids and titles (case-insensitive).

pastdays.description: Only tables updated within the last N days.

tools.name: table_info
tools.description: Metadata for a table: title, unit, last updated, and the full list of variables with their codes and valid value ids. READ THIS BEFORE get_data to learn the exact variable codes (e.g. "OMRÅDE", "Tid") and value ids you must pass.

tools.name: get_data
tools.description: Pull data from a table. Provide tableId and a "variables" map of {variableCode: valueOrValues}, using codes/ids from table_info. Each value may be a single id, an array of ids, or "*" for all. Omitted variables that allow elimination are aggregated to total. format "JSONSTAT" (default, structured JSON-stat) or "BULK"/"CSV" (semicolon-delimited text).

variables.description: Map of variable code -> value(s). Value is a string, an array of strings, or "*". Example: {"OMRÅDE":"000","Tid":["2024K1","2024K2"],"ALDER":"IALT"}.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dst-dk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dst-dk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
